faqs.a:
The council shall determine what amount or part of every expense shall be charged
               as an assessment and the tracts upon which the same shall be levied, and as often
               as the council deems it expedient, it shall require all of the several tracts chargeable
               therewith respectively to be reported by the city clerk to the engineer for assessment.
(Code 1981, § 27-99; Ord. No. 551, § 39, 5-14-1964)
